name: Customize - Privacy Settings
description: Applies Windows privacy and suggested-content settings. HKCU-based settings are applied to the Default user profile so all new users inherit them.

options.name: content
options.description: Content item containing the Set-PrivacySettings.ps1 script

options.name: scriptName
options.description: Name of the PowerShell script inside the content item

options.name: DisableTelemetry
options.description: Disables the advertising ID, tailored experiences, online speech recognition, inking/typing personalization, diagnostic data (AllowTelemetry), activity history, app-launch tracking, feedback prompts, and Edge personalization/diagnostic reporting.

options.name: DisableWindowsSuggestions
options.displayName: Disable tips, tricks & suggested content throughout Windows
options.description: Disables the Windows welcome experience, Start suggestions and recommendations, tips while using Windows, suggested content in Settings, account and sync provider notifications, silent suggested-app installs, Phone Link suggestions, and backup reminder notifications.

options.name: DisableLocationServices
options.displayName: Disable Windows location services & app location access
options.description: Disables the Windows location service system-wide via the LocationAndSensors policy.

options.name: DisableFindMyDevice
options.displayName: Disable Find My Device location tracking
options.description: Disables Find My Device via the FindMyDevice policy.

options.name: DisableLockscreenTips
options.displayName: Disable tips & tricks on the lock screen
options.description: Disables fun facts, tips and rotating overlay content on the lock screen.

options.name: DisableDesktopSpotlight
options.description: Disables the Windows Spotlight desktop wallpaper collection and removes the 'Learn about this picture' desktop icon entry.

options.name: DisableEdgeAds
options.displayName: Disable ads, suggestions and newsfeed in Edge
options.description: Disables the Edge new tab page MSN newsfeed and sponsored content, shopping assistant, tab services suggestions, alternate error pages, feedback prompts, recommendations, wallet donation prompts, and default-browser campaigns.

options.name: DisableSettings365Ads
options.displayName: Hide Microsoft 365 Copilot ads in Settings Home
options.description: Hides Microsoft 365 consumer account advertisements on the Settings Home page via the DisableConsumerAccountStateContent policy.
